headline: Iran Says It Is Ready to Withstand US Blockade; Seeks to Curb Price Rises
summary: Iran's first vice president said Tehran was not concerned about the US naval blockade. The remarks were made as Iran seeks to curb rising prices.
why: Iran is a major oil producer, and naval blockades can disrupt crude flows through the Gulf region, affecting global energy prices.
why_moved: The blockade and Iran's defiant stance raise concerns about oil supply disruption in a region central to global crude flows.
original_headline: Irán asegura estar preparado para resistir el bloqueo de EU; busca frenar subida de los precios
